source: Buffer (post metadata) + Instagram (visual review via browser)
scope: Static + Carousel cover frames only. 177 Reels/Stories excluded — video and 24h-ephemeral content not in scope yet.
notes: PATTERN — Third consecutive cycle with in-studio third-party activations lacking documented partner approval: June (Jous Drink, Patriot IV), July (Pure Green, Ebkinis Swimwear, Lela's), August (Juiced Today). Six activations across five studios with no verifiable approvals. Recommend escalating as a policy gap rather than per-studio flags.

AUDIT INTEGRITY — 3 of 4 Coral Gables posts were deleted between the Buffer pull and the visual review. Confirmed as genuine deletions (retested after an 18-second delay, still unavailable), not rate-limiting. Supports auditing closer to publication date.

COLORS & TYPOGRAPHY — Network-wide application is strong. Approved blue #00A3E0, mint #00FFC2 and condensed italic caps are used consistently. NoDa 'AUGUST EVENTS' and Midtown '250 CLUB' are exemplary. Doral is the only creative with off-brand type and background.

flags.caption: BOOTY BOOTCAMP WITH COACH MELANIE — It's that time of month again!!! This weekend, August 15 at 1:00–1:45 PM.
flags.why: Four issues compound in one creative. (1) Brand voice: 'BOOTY' as the dominant headline centers a body part rather than the training, departing from the approved energetic/encouraging/motivational tone with a 60–75% female audience. (2) Unintended double entendre: 'It's that time of month again!!!' is a common menstruation euphemism and reads crudely next to 'BOOTY BOOTCAMP'. (3) Typography: that line uses a serif/slab face that is not Oswald, Open Sans or Prohibition — no other fonts are permitted. (4) Background: dominant black, while the guide specifies white or primary blue backgrounds, with dark neutrals reserved for body text and small UI. Compliant elements: blue banner #00A3E0, mint chevrons #00FFC2, headline set in approved condensed italic.
flags.action: Review headline wording with the studio and reissue with approved typography and background. Confirm whether this class name is used network-wide — if so, escalate as a naming decision rather than a single-studio correction.

flags.caption: JUICED TODAY — POST WORKOUT JUICE SAMPLES. In studio, Tuesday August 11, 4:30PM–7:00PM. Collab post with @juicedtodaywithtreva.
flags.why: Third-party co-branding: the Juiced Today logo sits in a white box directly alongside the SWEAT440 lockup, promoting an in-studio sampling activation, published as an Instagram collab with the vendor's account. No evidence the vendor is on the approved partners list. The creative itself is fully on-brand — approved blue #00A3E0, mint #00FFC2 accents, correct condensed italic typography — so this is a partner-policy flag, not a design flag.
flags.action: Verify whether Juiced Today is an approved partner. If not, document the local partnership approval process with the franchisee. See cycle note on the recurring pattern.

flags.caption: OFFICIALLY IN THE 100 CLUB! No shortcuts. No excuses. Just showing up, one class at a time.
flags.why: Caption finding, surfaced outside this cycle's visual-only scope. 'No excuses' appears on the brand guide's prohibited language list as shame-based phrasing that conflicts with the approved encouraging tone. The creative itself is clean and on-brand: member holding the 100 CLUB tee against the blue shield wall.
flags.action: Share the prohibited-language list with the studio. Low urgency — single instance, positive intent.
